messages.author: f8f4b040f036a918
messages.subject: Normalisation in MSstatsPTM
parts:
Dear MSstats Team, 

I would like to enquire about normalisation in MSstatsPTM. After dataSummarizationPTM, the QC plot looks like it has not normalised - see image attached. I used the default normalisation setting "equalizeMedians". 
When I checked the QC plot after re-running the dataSummarizationPTM step with no normalisation, there was very little different to the previous plot after normalisation - see image attached.

What might be happening?

I am using MSstats 4.0 
R Studio 2024.04.2+764


Kind regards
Suniya

Dear MSstats Team, 

Following on from my previous questions, I was wondering if you had any thoughts on the normalisation. 

I had a look at Abundance from FeatureLevel data for the Groups and this looks more normalised with equal median than at the Run level. Please see plots attached. 
Is this something you have noticed before? 
Why might the abundances be normalised at group level and not run level? Is there a case when this might be true?

I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Suniya

messages.author: 6597c45f2a31b5d0
messages.subject: Re: Normalisation in MSstatsPTM
parts:
Hi Suniya,

That's a good question on whether the issue is in dataProcessPlotsPTM or the data summarization function.  

As far as I can tell, the normalization step was done correctly in the data summarization function.  The code pointer I sent demonstrates how the dataProcessPlotsPTM function overwrites the abundance values that were initially processed by the data summarization function.  This overwriting is a bug and should not be happening.

Regarding timeline, I'm aiming to push the bug fix to bioconductor by end of this week.


Thanks,
Tony
